# Textures for the 3D street view

All CC0 (public domain dedication), resized to 512 px (roughness 256 px) and saved as WebP by the build step described
below. build.py embeds them in the page as data URIs.

| File prefix | Source asset | Site |
|---|---|---|
| `brick_*` | red_brick_03 | Poly Haven, polyhaven.com/a/red_brick_03 |
| `siding_*` | white_planks_clean (laid horizontal in the page as lap siding) | Poly Haven |
| `stucco_*` | white_stucco_02 | Poly Haven |
| `metal_*` | box_profile_metal_sheet (colour made grey, the page tints it) | Poly Haven |
| `asphalt_*` | asphalt_02 | Poly Haven |
| `concrete_*` | concrete_floor_01 | Poly Haven |
| `grass_*` | leafy_grass | Poly Haven |
| `bark_*` | bark_brown_02 | Poly Haven |
| `shingle_*` | grey_roof_01 (normal and roughness only: roofs carry the aerial imagery) | Poly Haven |
| `leaves_card` | leaves of LeafSet024 scattered on twigs into one card with transparency | ambientCG, ambientcg.com/view?id=LeafSet024 |

`_diff` is colour (sRGB), `_nor` an OpenGL normal map, `_rough` roughness.
